steps.title: God loves you
steps.text: God made you, and He loves you. He loved the world so much that He gave His only begotten Son, Jesus, so that whosoever believeth in Him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

verses.t: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

steps.title: We have all sinned
steps.text: Sin is breaking God's law: doing what God says is wrong, or not doing what He says is right. Every one of us has sinned. "All have sinned, and come short of the glory of God."

verses.t: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;

steps.title: Sin brings death
steps.text: Sin separates us from a holy God. "The wages of sin is death," but God offers a gift instead: "eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord."

verses.t: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

steps.title: Christ died for us
steps.text: We could not save ourselves, so God came to save us. Jesus, the Son of God, lived without sin, died on the cross in our place, and rose again the third day. "While we were yet sinners, Christ died for us."

verses.t: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

steps.title: Not by works
steps.text: Salvation is a free gift. We cannot earn it by being good, going to church or being baptized. "By grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: not of works, lest any man should boast."

verses.t: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:
Not of works, lest any man should boast.

steps.title: Believe and confess
steps.text: God asks us to turn from our sin and trust Jesus alone to save us. "If thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved."

verses.t: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.

steps.title: Call on Him today
steps.text: This promise is for anyone. "Whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved." You can talk to God right now, tell Him you know you are a sinner, and ask Jesus to save you.

verses.t: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.

next.title: Tell someone
next.text: Tell a Christian you trust, a parent or your pastor what God has done. Following Jesus is not meant to be done alone.

verses.t: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.

next.title: Be baptized
next.text: Baptism does not save you, but Jesus commands those who believe to be baptized as a picture of His death, burial and resurrection.

verses.t: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.

next.title: Join a local church
next.text: God gives us a church family to worship, learn and serve together.

verses.t: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.

next.title: Read the Gospel of John
next.text: Start with John chapter 1 and read a chapter a day to get to know Jesus.

verses.t: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.

next.title: Pray every day
next.text: Talk to God as your Father. He hears you.

verses.t: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
